main.description: What someone does to hold their world together, on the Atlas of Care: one sentence in their own words that begins with "I", and a place. It lives in the repo of whoever says it, so nobody writes one about someone else. It is placed in an administrative unit, not at an address.

atlas.description: The atlas this statement is for. The backlink index finds statements by this field.

text.description: One line that begins with "I". No web address and no @-mention in it.

url.description: Optional. A web address for the thing they do.

scope.description: Which of the atlas's maps the unit belongs to.

unit.description: The unit's id on that map: ISO alpha-3 country, US county FIPS, geoBoundaries shape id, or NUTS-2 code.

lat.description: Latitude of the unit's centre, as a decimal string with two places.

lon.description: Longitude of the unit's centre, as a decimal string with two places.
